item.title: Singapore revamps baby bonus scheme: Will it boost birth rates?
item.description: Unlikely to have a significant impact.

item.title: Gen X should not count on an inheritance that may never come
item.description: Gen X faces tough realities: less savings than the previous generation, no pension safety net, and financial obligations in both directions.

item.title: Women's soccer faces scheduling crunch around World Cup, testing growth
item.description: The schedule was deliberately designed to place the NWSL at the heart of one of the biggest years in women's soccer, according to the commissioner.

item.title: AI economy compared to a bad dating app, stuck in pilot purgatory, reminiscent of dotcom bubble but worse
item.description: Futurist Amy Webb, who predicted AI's rise and a U.S.-China tech Cold War, expresses disappointment with current developments.
